title: Coroutines and Tasks
text: Coroutines declared with async def can be scheduled as tasks. asyncio.create_task schedules a coroutine concurrently and returns a Task object. Awaiting a task waits for its result.

title: Context managers
text: A context manager defines __enter__ and __exit__. The with statement calls __enter__ before the block and __exit__ when leaving it, including when an exception is raised.

title: JSON module
text: The json module serializes Python objects with json.dumps and deserializes JSON text with json.loads. JSON object keys are strings, so non-string keys may be coerced during encoding.

title: Logging
text: Python logging records events through Logger objects. A logger sends records to handlers, and handlers can apply filters and formatters. Logging levels control which records are emitted.

title: Exceptions
text: try statements handle exceptions with except clauses. A finally clause runs whether or not an exception occurs, making it suitable for cleanup. Bare except clauses should be avoided when possible.

title: Data classes
text: The dataclasses module provides a decorator that adds generated methods such as __init__ and __repr__ to classes based on annotated fields. frozen=True prevents assignment after initialization.

title: Pathlib
text: pathlib provides object-oriented filesystem paths. Path.read_text reads a file as text and Path.write_text writes text. Path objects work across operating systems.

title: Unit testing
text: unittest organizes tests in TestCase classes. Assertions such as assertEqual and assertRaises express expected behavior. A test runner discovers and executes test cases.
